Class JoinGameController

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am48.view.gui.JoinGameController
All Implemented Interfaces:
ModelObserver
public class JoinGameController extends Object implements ModelObserver
Controller for the "Join Game" screen where the player enters their nickname, selects the number of players, and starts a new game. Implements ModelObserver to react to state changes (game started or lobby wait).

    • onStateUpdated

      public void onStateUpdated(ClientGameState state)
      Called when the game state changes. Transitions to the loading lobby if waiting for players, or to the game board if the game has started. Unregisters this observer when the game board is reached.
      Specified by:
      onStateUpdated in interface ModelObserver
      Parameters:
      state - the updated client game state
